cyclical.reason: Normalizing to the 2017-2026 mean margin and a ~$68bn revenue trend ignores a 30x change in scale: Q3 FY27 guidance of $108bn (+12% q/q), reported FY28 guidance of about +70% (supply-constrained) and $279bn of supply commitments through FY29 give two to three years of demand visibility. The cycle is NOT dismissed: the bear case has a two-year downturn (FY29 -30%, FY30 -15%) like the history in SEC data (FY2009 -16%, FY2020 -7%) and the concentrated hyperscale buyers.

overrides.reason: FY28 +60%: below the reported +70% supply-constrained guidance (execution and memory supply risk) and near the post-call consensus of about $690bn; then a fast fade (FY29 +20%, FY30 +8%) because $87-88bn yearly supply commitments for FY28-29 do not imply another doubling and customers' capital spending cannot compound at this rate.

FY28 +35% (near the pre-guidance 44% consensus, supply or customer delays), then an AI-capex digestion: FY29 -30%, FY30 -15%, as concentrated hyperscale and AI-cloud buyers cut orders; the company's own history shows sharp declines when customer spending turned.
FY28 at the +70% guidance with demand above supply; slower fade (FY29 +35%, FY30 +18%) as Vera Rubin and the AI-cloud/sovereign buildout extend the cycle.

A downturn with $279bn of fixed supply commitments and $108.5bn of guarantees compresses margins well below today's 65%; 35% is above the FY2023 trough (about 16%) because of scale and software/networking mix, but far below the peak.

Terminal ROIC 30%: far below the demonstrated ~110% five-year average (SEC data) because concentrated buyers (five customers 10-22% of receivables each) and competition and regulatory pressure (inquiries in five jurisdictions) should erode returns, but well above the 12% engine default, which assumes no advantage at all for a company earning 75% gross margins.
Bear: returns fall close to the cost of capital as buyers' own accelerators and regulation compete away the advantage.
Bull: ecosystem and full-stack advantage keep returns high, still well below today's.
